description: This file contains a PHP class 'Flat' which is a controller for managing the 'Flat' shipping method extension in OpenCart. It defines methods for displaying the configuration form ('index') and saving settings ('save') within the admin panel.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Flat shipping extension in OpenCart's admin panel. Handles displaying the configuration form and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping Flat extension configuration page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Flat shipping extension settings via AJAX, returning success or error as JSON.
